line:

line:

line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

line:

z: 恷 amathambo olwanga, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 恷 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 恿 amathambo olwanga, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 恿 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 悁 amathambo olwanga, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 悁 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 悃 amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悃 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 悄 amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 悄 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 悅 amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 悅 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 悉 amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 悉 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 悊 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悊 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 悋 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 悋 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 悌 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 悌 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 悍 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 悍 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 悒 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悒 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 悔 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 悔 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 悕 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 悕 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 悖 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 悖 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 悗 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悗 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 悚 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 悚 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 悛 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 悛 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 悝 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 悝 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 悞 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悞 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 悟 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 悟 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 悠 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 悠 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Name the person you are afraid of losing, and spend the next hour near them without a speech.

z: 患 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 患 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 悦 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悦 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 悧 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 悧 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 您 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 您 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 悩 amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 悩 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 悪 amathambo olwanga, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by amathambo olwanga, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. 悪 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 悰 ithambo lomphimbo, ngaphambili, ngasohlangothini, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work of welcoming a guest. Here the body speaks by ithambo lomphimbo, ngaphambili, ngasohlangothini, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 悰 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.
